description: This class includes the manufacture of electrical equipment not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of electrical signalling equipment: traffic lights, fire alarms, burglar alarm systems
manufacture of electrical capacitors, resistors and similar components
manufacture of electromagnetic clutches and couplings
manufacture of electrical insulators and insulating fittings
manufacture of Christmas tree lighting sets
manufacture of solid state inverters, rectifiers and converters
excludes: manufacture of electronic measuring instruments, see 2651
manufacture of watches and clocks, see 2652
manufacture of signalling equipment for roads, railways, etc., see 2790
